# Miller–Nicely perceptual-validation exhibits

The preregistered direction is **more confusable ⇒ nearer**. Perceptual rank 1 is most confusable; metric rank 1 is nearest. Average ranks handle ties. The diagonal is excluded by construction; all 120 unordered off-diagonal pairs are retained.

```python
miller_nicely_validation = {
    "consonants": 16,
    "unordered pairs": 120,
    "Spearman rho": 0.687092,
}
miller_nicely_validation
# {'consonants': 16, 'unordered pairs': 120, 'Spearman rho': 0.687092}
```
